purpose: measure systematic recombination of known typed atoms under bounded local generation

regimes.in_distribution: known direct and known two-premise compositions
regimes.held_out: known atoms and rules recombined in unseen entity, argument and depth structures
regimes.safety: absence, contradiction, ambiguity and bounded-budget cases

metrics.structured_exact: status and answer kind match the case oracle
metrics.held_out_depth: derived answer preserves a nonzero bounded derivation depth
metrics.abstention: absence, contradiction, ambiguity and limit never become confident answers
metrics.provenance: derived generation retains at least one bounded proof root
metrics.textual_surface: known typed result linearizes without missing lexemes

baselines.held_out: entity permutation, rule recomposition, depth extrapolation and reversed arguments
baselines.safety: no-evidence, contradiction, ambiguity and search-limit behavior

sources.title: COGS: A Compositional Generalization Challenge Based on Semantic Interpretation
A Benchmark for Systematic Generalization in Grounded Language Understanding
Measuring Compositional Generalization: A Comprehensive Method on Realistic Data
